scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.check: npm run cf:typegen && npm run check --workspaces --if-present
scripts.preview: npm run build && npx wrangler dev --config apps/web/wrangler.jsonc --config apps/api/wrangler.jsonc --port 4321 --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.deploy: npm run check && npm run build && npm run db:migrate:remote && npm run deploy:api && npx wrangler deploy --config apps/web/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:local: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config apps/api/wrangler.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.db:migrate:remote: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config apps/api/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:info: npx wrangler d1 info luvo-db --config apps/api/wrangler.jsonc
